_comment: The setup assistant that the first-run wizard starts in the Setup channel. Plain data. The agent reads its brief from data/roles/personalities/Guide.md. It uses the read-only researcher role, so it cannot edit files.
name: Guide
channelDescription: Ask the Guide about anything OpenFlow can do and how to set it up
firstMessage: Hello Guide. In two sentences, what can you help me set up, and what is already set up?
